entries.title: Job 37:1
segments: ¶"At this also my heart trembles, And leaps from its place.

entries.title: Job 37:2
segments: Hear attentively the thunder of His voice, And the rumbling [that] comes from His mouth.

entries.title: Job 37:3
segments: He sends it forth under the whole heaven, His lightning to the ends of the earth.

entries.title: Job 37:4
segments: After it a voice roars; He thunders with His majestic voice, And He does not restrain them when His voice is heard.

entries.title: Job 37:5
segments: God thunders marvelously with His voice; He does great things which we cannot comprehend.

entries.title: Job 37:6
segments: ¶For He says to the snow, 'Fall [on] the earth'; Likewise to the gentle rain and the heavy rain of His strength.

entries.title: Job 37:7
segments: He seals the hand of every man, That all men may know His work.

entries.title: Job 37:8
segments: The beasts go into dens, And remain in their lairs.

entries.title: Job 37:9
segments: From the chamber [of the south] comes the whirlwind, And cold from the scattering winds [of the north].

entries.title: Job 37:10
segments: By the breath of God ice is given, And the broad waters are frozen.

entries.title: Job 37:11
segments: Also with moisture He saturates the thick clouds; He scatters His bright clouds.

entries.title: Job 37:12
segments: And they swirl about, being turned by His guidance, That they may do whatever He commands them On the face of the whole earth.

entries.title: Job 37:13
segments: He causes it to come, Whether for correction, Or for His land, Or for mercy.

entries.title: Job 37:14
segments: ¶"Listen to this, O Job; Stand still and consider the wondrous works of God.

entries.title: Job 37:15
segments: Do you know when God dispatches them, And causes the light of His cloud to shine?

entries.title: Job 37:16
segments: Do you know how the clouds are balanced, Those wondrous works of Him who is perfect in knowledge?

entries.title: Job 37:17
segments: Why [are] your garments hot, When He quiets the earth by the south [wind]?

entries.title: Job 37:18
segments: With Him, have you spread out the skies, Strong as a cast metal mirror?

entries.title: Job 37:19
segments: "Teach us what we should say to Him, [For] we can prepare nothing because of the darkness.

entries.title: Job 37:20
segments: Should He be told that I [wish to] speak? If a man were to speak, surely he would be swallowed up.

entries.title: Job 37:21
segments: ¶Even now [men] cannot look at the light [when it is] bright in the skies, When the wind has passed and cleared them.

entries.title: Job 37:22
segments: He comes from the north [as] golden [splendor]; With God [is] awesome majesty.

entries.title: Job 37:23
segments: As [for] the Almighty, we cannot find Him; [He is] excellent in power, [In] judgment and abundant justice; He does not oppress.

entries.title: Job 37:24
segments: Therefore men fear Him; He shows no partiality to any [who are] wise of heart."
